doors.trait: Getting ready is where you hide, and it photographs as diligence from every angle. As long as you are still preparing, nobody can grade the real attempt, and part of you has arranged your studying life around that protection. Somewhere the preparing stopped serving the step and started replacing it.
doors.scene: Seventeen browser tabs, two saved courses, a notebook full of plans. The project they all point at has not moved in a month, but the researching of it has never gone better. One more book, you tell yourself, and the telling sounds exactly like last time.
doors.outside: To everyone watching, you are the responsible one, always studying, always ready. Only you know the math underneath: as long as you are still getting ready, nobody can say you failed. It is a clever shelter, and it keeps out progress as reliably as it keeps out judgment.
